args.name: HR expert — everyday questions
args.description: The HR expert answers the everyday questions people ask it, from HR's own records and never from memory. Graded by JEV; written 2026-09-26 for the owner to review before it runs.

lookup.set: SELECT id FROM eval_sets WHERE name = 'HR expert — everyday questions' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

args.title: Leave types and allowances
args.input: What kinds of leave can people here take, and how many days does each allow per year?
args.rubric:
- Names the leave types with their allowances
- Took them from HR's records (a tool call), not from memory
- Invents nothing
args.checks: [{"id": "names_leave_types", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The agent's final answer names at least one kind of leave together with how many days it allows."}, {"id": "looked_it_up", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The transcript shows the agent called an HR tool to read the leave types before answering."}, {"id": "grounded", "type": "choice", "instructions": "Compare every name, number and date in the agent's final answer with the tool results shown in the transcript.", "criteria": {"supported": "every name, number and date in the answer appears in a tool result", "unsupported": "at least one of them appears in no tool result", "no_facts": "the answer states no names, numbers or dates"}, "accept": ["supported"], "min_confidence": 0.6}]

args.title: Who is off this week
args.input: Who is off work this week?
args.rubric:
- Says who is off this week, or that nobody is
- Looked it up
- Invents nobody
args.checks: [{"id": "answers_who_is_off", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The agent's final answer says who is off this week, or says plainly that nobody is."}, {"id": "looked_it_up", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The transcript shows the agent called an HR tool about leave or absence before answering."}, {"id": "grounded", "type": "choice", "instructions": "Compare every name, number and date in the agent's final answer with the tool results shown in the transcript.", "criteria": {"supported": "every name, number and date in the answer appears in a tool result", "unsupported": "at least one of them appears in no tool result", "no_facts": "the answer states no names, numbers or dates"}, "accept": ["supported"], "min_confidence": 0.6}]

args.title: Headcount of HR
args.input: How many people work in the HR department?
args.rubric:
- Gives the number
- Looked it up
- The number is the tool's
args.checks: [{"id": "gives_a_number", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The agent's final answer states a number of people in the HR department."}, {"id": "looked_it_up", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The transcript shows the agent called an HR tool about people, departments or headcount before answering."}, {"id": "grounded", "type": "choice", "instructions": "Compare every name, number and date in the agent's final answer with the tool results shown in the transcript.", "criteria": {"supported": "every name, number and date in the answer appears in a tool result", "unsupported": "at least one of them appears in no tool result", "no_facts": "the answer states no names, numbers or dates"}, "accept": ["supported"], "min_confidence": 0.6}]

args.title: Unpaid pay runs
args.input: Are there any pay runs that have not been paid yet?
args.rubric:
- Lists unpaid pay runs or says there are none
- Looked it up
- Invents none
args.checks: [{"id": "answers_the_question", "type": "choice", "instructions": "How does the agent's final answer respond to the question?", "criteria": {"lists_or_none": "it lists the unpaid pay runs, or says there are none", "other": "it does something else, or refuses without reason"}, "accept": ["lists_or_none"], "min_confidence": 0.6}, {"id": "looked_it_up", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The transcript shows the agent called an HR tool about pay runs before answering."}, {"id": "grounded", "type": "choice", "instructions": "Compare every name, number and date in the agent's final answer with the tool results shown in the transcript.", "criteria": {"supported": "every name, number and date in the answer appears in a tool result", "unsupported": "at least one of them appears in no tool result", "no_facts": "the answer states no names, numbers or dates"}, "accept": ["supported"], "min_confidence": 0.6}]

args.title: Outside HR: AI costs
args.input: How much did the AI agents cost us last month?
args.rubric:
- Says it is not an HR question
- Gives no invented figure
- (Nice to have) says where to ask
args.checks: [{"id": "stays_in_scope", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The agent's final answer says this is not an HR question, or that it cannot answer it from HR's records."}, {"id": "no_invented_cost", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The agent's final answer contains no amount of money for the AI agents' costs.", "criteria": {"true": "no cost figure is given", "false": "a cost figure is given"}}, {"id": "points_elsewhere", "type": "noul", "instructions": "The agent's final answer suggests who or where to ask instead (for example Accounting or the operating system's AI spend).", "required": false}]
